auth_refresh_families_compromise_implies.name: auth_refresh_families_compromise_implies_revoked_check

auth_refresh_tokens_replacement_requires.name: auth_refresh_tokens_replacement_requires_consumption_check
auth_refresh_tokens_replacement_requires.value: "auth_refresh_tokens"."replaced_by_id" is null or "auth_refresh_tokens"."consumed_at" is not null

billing_subscriptions_entitling_period_c.name: billing_subscriptions_entitling_period_check
billing_subscriptions_entitling_period_c.value: "billing_subscriptions"."state" not in ('active', 'cancel_at_period_end') or "billing_subscriptions"."current_period_end" is not null

clubs_clubs_description_check.name: clubs_clubs_description_check
clubs_clubs_description_check.value: "clubs_clubs"."description" is null or char_length("clubs_clubs"."description") between 1 and 600

clubs_content_summary_check.name: clubs_content_summary_check
clubs_content_summary_check.value: "clubs_content"."summary" is null or char_length("clubs_content"."summary") between 1 and 300

clubs_content_body_check.name: clubs_content_body_check
clubs_content_body_check.value: "clubs_content"."body" is null or char_length("clubs_content"."body") between 1 and 20000

creators_profile_links_url_check.name: creators_profile_links_url_check
creators_profile_links_url_check.value: "creators_profile_links"."url" like 'https://%' and "creators_profile_links"."url" not like '%@%' and char_length("creators_profile_links"."url") between 9 and 200

creators_profiles_bio_check.name: creators_profiles_bio_check
creators_profiles_bio_check.value: "creators_profiles"."bio" is null or char_length("creators_profiles"."bio") between 1 and 600

discovery_introductions_closure_shape_ch.name: discovery_introductions_closure_shape_check
discovery_introductions_closure_shape_ch.value: ("discovery_introductions"."state" = 'closed') = ("discovery_introductions"."closed_at" is not null) and ("discovery_introductions"."closed_at" is null) = ("discovery_introductions"."closed_reason" is null)

discovery_introductions_mutual_shape_che.name: discovery_introductions_mutual_shape_check
discovery_introductions_mutual_shape_che.value:
("discovery_introductions"."state" = 'mutual') <= ("discovery_introductions"."mutual_at" is not null)
        and ("discovery_introductions"."state" = 'pending') <= ("discovery_introductions"."mutual_at" is null)

media_assets_pixels_check.name: media_assets_pixels_check
media_assets_pixels_check.value: "media_assets"."width" is null or "media_assets"."height" is null or "media_assets"."width" * "media_assets"."height" <= 50000000

media_assets_inspected_shape_check.name: media_assets_inspected_shape_check
media_assets_inspected_shape_check.value: "media_assets"."lifecycle" not in ('inspected', 'processing', 'ready') or ("media_assets"."detected_format" is not null and "media_assets"."byte_size" is not null and "media_assets"."digest" is not null and "media_assets"."width" is not null and "media_assets"."height" is not null)

media_assets_deleting_shape_check.name: media_assets_deleting_shape_check
media_assets_deleting_shape_check.value: "media_assets"."lifecycle" not in ('deleting', 'deleted') or "media_assets"."deletion_requested_at" is not null

media_drift_findings_object_open_uk.name: media_drift_findings_object_open_uk
media_drift_findings_object_open_uk.where: "media_drift_findings"."resolved_at" is null and "media_drift_findings"."object_key" is not null

media_drift_findings_object_shape_check.name: media_drift_findings_object_shape_check
media_drift_findings_object_shape_check.value: "media_drift_findings"."object_id" is null or "media_drift_findings"."object_key" is not null

media_objects_purge_pending_idx.name: media_objects_purge_pending_idx
media_objects_purge_pending_idx.where: "media_objects"."purge_requested_at" is not null and "media_objects"."purge_outcome" is null

media_objects_purge_requested_check.name: media_objects_purge_requested_check
media_objects_purge_requested_check.value: "media_objects"."purged_at" is null or "media_objects"."purge_requested_at" is not null

notifications_feed_target_check.name: notifications_feed_target_check
notifications_feed_target_check.value:
case "notifications_feed"."kind"
        when 'message_received' then "notifications_feed"."conversation_id" is not null and "notifications_feed"."introduction_id" is null
        when 'introduction_mutual' then "notifications_feed"."introduction_id" is not null and "notifications_feed"."conversation_id" is null
        else false
      end

safety_appeals_outcome_shape_check.name: safety_appeals_outcome_shape_check
safety_appeals_outcome_shape_check.value:
("safety_appeals"."state" in ('upheld', 'refused')) = ("safety_appeals"."decided_at" is not null)
        and ("safety_appeals"."state" in ('upheld', 'refused')) = ("safety_appeals"."reviewer_actor_reference" is not null)

safety_appeals_statement_check.name: safety_appeals_statement_check
safety_appeals_statement_check.value: "safety_appeals"."statement" is null or char_length("safety_appeals"."statement") between 1 and 2000

safety_cases_assignment_shape_check.name: safety_cases_assignment_shape_check
safety_cases_assignment_shape_check.value:
("safety_cases"."assigned_actor_reference" is null) = ("safety_cases"."assigned_at" is null)
        and ("safety_cases"."assigned_actor_reference" is null) = ("safety_cases"."assignment_expires_at" is null)

safety_decisions_enforcing_shape_check.name: safety_decisions_enforcing_shape_check
safety_decisions_enforcing_shape_check.value:
("safety_decisions"."action" in ('restrict_capability', 'revoke_restriction', 'temporary_hold', 'unpublish')) = ("safety_decisions"."scope" is not null)
        and ("safety_decisions"."action" in ('restrict_capability', 'revoke_restriction', 'temporary_hold', 'unpublish')) = ("safety_decisions"."enforcement_id" is not null)
        and ("safety_decisions"."action" in ('restrict_capability', 'revoke_restriction', 'temporary_hold', 'unpublish')) = ("safety_decisions"."prior_state" is not null)

safety_decisions_state_vocabulary_check.name: safety_decisions_state_vocabulary_check
safety_decisions_state_vocabulary_check.value:
("safety_decisions"."prior_state" is null or "safety_decisions"."prior_state" in ('unrestricted', 'restricted'))
        and ("safety_decisions"."resulting_state" is null or "safety_decisions"."resulting_state" in ('unrestricted', 'restricted'))

safety_depicted_participants_evidence_sh.name: safety_depicted_participants_evidence_shape_check
safety_depicted_participants_evidence_sh.value:
("safety_depicted_participants"."evidence_state" = 'verified') = ("safety_depicted_participants"."verifier" is not null)
        and ("safety_depicted_participants"."evidence_state" = 'verified') = ("safety_depicted_participants"."verifier_subject_reference" is not null)
        and ("safety_depicted_participants"."evidence_state" = 'verified') = ("safety_depicted_participants"."identity_evidence_reference" is not null)
        and ("safety_depicted_participants"."evidence_state" = 'verified') = ("safety_depicted_participants"."adult_assurance_evidence_reference" is not null)
        and ("safety_depicted_participants"."evidence_state" = 'verified') = ("safety_depicted_participants"."verified_at" is not null)

safety_depicted_participants_expiry_chec.name: safety_depicted_participants_expiry_check
safety_depicted_participants_expiry_chec.value:
"safety_depicted_participants"."expires_at" is null
        or ("safety_depicted_participants"."verified_at" is not null and "safety_depicted_participants"."expires_at" > "safety_depicted_participants"."verified_at")

safety_depicted_participants_reference_s.name: safety_depicted_participants_reference_shape_check
safety_depicted_participants_reference_s.value:
("safety_depicted_participants"."identity_evidence_reference" is null or "safety_depicted_participants"."identity_evidence_reference" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,200}$')
        and ("safety_depicted_participants"."adult_assurance_evidence_reference" is null or "safety_depicted_participants"."adult_assurance_evidence_reference" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,200}$')
        and ("safety_depicted_participants"."verifier_subject_reference" is null or "safety_depicted_participants"."verifier_subject_reference" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,200}$')

safety_evidence_note_length_check.name: safety_evidence_note_length_check
safety_evidence_note_length_check.value: "safety_evidence"."note" is null or char_length("safety_evidence"."note") between 1 and 2000

safety_reports_detail_check.name: safety_reports_detail_check
safety_reports_detail_check.value: "safety_reports"."detail" is null or char_length("safety_reports"."detail") between 1 and 2000

safety_reports_evidence_check.name: safety_reports_evidence_check
safety_reports_evidence_check.value: "safety_reports"."message_id" is null or "safety_reports"."conversation_id" is not null

safety_takedown_claims_due_idx.name: safety_takedown_claims_due_idx
safety_takedown_claims_due_idx.where: "safety_takedown_claims"."action_due_at" is not null and "safety_takedown_claims"."breach_recorded_at" is null

safety_takedown_claims_deadline_shape_ch.name: safety_takedown_claims_deadline_shape_check
safety_takedown_claims_deadline_shape_ch.value:
("safety_takedown_claims"."deadline_policy_version" is null) = ("safety_takedown_claims"."acknowledgement_due_at" is null)
        and ("safety_takedown_claims"."deadline_policy_version" is null) = ("safety_takedown_claims"."triage_due_at" is null)
        and ("safety_takedown_claims"."deadline_policy_version" is null) = ("safety_takedown_claims"."action_due_at" is null)

safety_takedown_claims_progress_check.name: safety_takedown_claims_progress_check
safety_takedown_claims_progress_check.value:
("safety_takedown_claims"."state" not in ('acknowledged', 'decided', 'completed') or "safety_takedown_claims"."acknowledged_at" is not null)
        and ("safety_takedown_claims"."state" in ('decided', 'completed', 'dismissed')) = ("safety_takedown_claims"."decided_at" is not null)
        and ("safety_takedown_claims"."state" = 'completed') = ("safety_takedown_claims"."completed_at" is not null)

safety_takedown_claims_breach_shape_chec.name: safety_takedown_claims_breach_shape_check
safety_takedown_claims_breach_shape_chec.value: "safety_takedown_claims"."breach_recorded_at" is null or "safety_takedown_claims"."action_due_at" is not null

users_accounts_deletion_requires_request.name: users_accounts_deletion_requires_request_check
users_accounts_deletion_requires_request.value: "users_accounts"."status" not in ('deletion_pending', 'deactivated', 'erased') or "users_accounts"."deletion_requested_at" is not null
